description: This file defines the interface IOCIContainer within the WPEFramework's Exchange namespace. It includes enumerations, nested notification structures, and pure virtual methods for managing containers, such as starting, stopping, pausing, resuming, and querying container states, as well as handling notifications.

classes.name: IOCIContainer
classes.description: An interface representing a container management system, providing methods to control and query container states and properties within the WPEFramework.

classes.name: IOCIContainer::INotification
classes.description: An internal notification interface for container events such as start, stop, failure, and state change notifications.
